_comment: Characterization snapshot of sleap_roots_analyze.clean_traits_for_analysis (cleanup+validate only) on the raw turface_19 input, called with the reader-detected role + trait columns (exactly as the qc_clean tool calls it). NOT the #120 post-QC final table (that is the full QCPipeline). Demonstrates trait-first cleanup minimizing sample loss vs naive dropna. As of #403 trait detection delegates to sleap_roots_analyze.get_trait_columns, which excludes the numeric metadata column Computation.Time.s from the trait set: detected traits 20 -> 19, and the cleaned trait count 18 -> 17 (Computation.Time.s is NaN-free so it previously survived cleaning). Sample counts are unchanged because the excluded column carried no NaNs.
